Accessibility information

This slice uses semantic pages, keyboard interaction, visible focus, equivalent text versions and named status messages. Diagrammatic examples remain readable as text. Resources are offered as HTML, PDF and Markdown.

The current test report describes the checks performed and known limitations. A full manual screen-reader assessment and formal conformance assessment are still outstanding. This information does not claim full statutory conformance.
